title: クロックワーク・レジスタンス ―雨の街のデバッグ・ログ―
author: 百目鬼 シン

en.title: Clockwork Resistance —Debug Logs of the Rainy City—
en.premise: In a highly advanced AI-managed society, I live as a 'Debugger,' tasked with correcting data inconsistencies. One day, while pursuing an inexplicable 'bug' within the system, I stumble upon a mysterious underground shop called 'Pulse's Hideout' that only opens on rainy days. The data I retrieve there is a forbidden code capable of rewriting the very foundations of the city. Will I be the administrator who preserves the urban order, or the bug that destroys it all? In search of the truth hidden upon the Promised Hill, I race through the electronic battlefield.

zh.title: 发条抵抗军 ―雨之城的调试日志―
zh.premise: 在高度AI管理的社会中，我作为一名修正数据矛盾的“调试员”生活着。某天，在追查系统上不可思议的“漏洞”时，我偶然发现了一家仅在雨天才会开门的神秘地下店——“脉冲避难所”。在那里获得的资料，竟是足以改写城市基石的禁忌代码。是维护城市秩序的管理者，还是摧毁一切的漏洞？为了寻找隐藏在“约定之丘”的真相，我将在电子战场上疾驰。
